title: Xe Đạp TWITTER T10 PRO R7120 • Full Carbon & R7120 2*12

takeaways.text: The top T10 Pro build has a full Shimano 105 R7120 2×12 hydraulic groupset with an M6100 chain, on a T800 carbon frame with 3K finish and a flattened aero fork.
Priced around 30 million dong at this shop, which offers its own five-year frame warranty.
Three sizes (46, 48 and 50, with 500–525 mm top tubes) for riders about 1.52–1.82 m.

disclosure: A Vietnamese retailer presenting a bike it sells, with its own five-year warranty offer; Vietnamese automatic captions.
summary: A Vietnamese shop's walkaround of the TWITTER T10 Pro in its full Shimano 105 R7120 build.
